name: awesome-iocs
desc: Curated sources of indicators of compromise, detection signatures and IOC tools.

resources.name: CIRCL OSINT Feed
resources.desc: CIRCL's public MISP feed of indicators from open-source reporting, ready to subscribe to from a MISP instance.

resources.name: Cisco-Talos/IOCs
resources.desc: IOCs from Cisco Talos.

resources.name: CyberBriefing IOC API
resources.desc: Vendor-operated REST API that puts active IOCs from public feeds (AlienVault OTX, Abuse.ch URLhaus, ThreatFox, CISA KEV, Tor exit nodes, OpenPhish) behind one query interface; free tier requires an API key.

resources.name: DomainTools-Investigations/Malware-and-Scams
resources.desc: IOCs from DomainTools for malware and scams.

resources.name: DomainTools-Investigations/Nation-State-Threats
resources.desc: IOCs from DomainTools for nation-state threats.

resources.name: Extuno Malicious Package Database
resources.desc: Vendor-operated database of malicious browser extensions and packages across 12 ecosystems (Chrome, Firefox, VS Code, npm, PyPI, WordPress and others), aggregated from OSV, OpenSSF and vendor feeds, for checking software supply-chain exposure; free web lookup and JSON endpoint.

resources.name: Neo23x0/signature-base
resources.desc: YARA rules and IOCs behind the LOKI and THOR Lite scanners, curated for a low false-positive rate and updated frequently.

resources.name: PaloAltoNetworks/Unit42-Threat-Intelligence-Article-Information
resources.desc: IOCs and supporting data for Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 threat research articles, so indicators can be traced back to their write-up.

resources.name: ThreatCluster Public IOC Feed
resources.desc: Vendor-operated feed of indicators extracted from clustered public reporting, available as TXT, CSV and JSON.

resources.name: ThreatView Feeds
resources.desc: Free daily blocklists of malicious IPs, domains, URLs and file hashes, plus a C2 hunt feed of command-and-control servers with beacon configs; included in MISP's default feed list.

resources.name: aptnotes/data
resources.desc: Index of public reports on APT campaigns sorted by year, useful for tracing indicators back to the original vendor reporting.

resources.name: botherder/targetedthreats
resources.desc: Network indicators from reports on the targeting of civil society, published as CSV, JSON and generated Snort rules.

resources.name: citizenlab/malware-indicators
resources.desc: Indicators from Citizen Lab investigations into targeted attacks on civil society, one directory per report.

resources.name: cystack/stealer-fingerprints
resources.desc: Fingerprints of infostealer log formats (banner strings, field signatures, YARA rules) for 30+ families including RedLine, Vidar, Lumma and StealC, for identifying which stealer produced a leaked log.

resources.name: eset/malware-ioc
resources.desc: Indicators from ESET research publications, one directory per report and actively updated.

resources.name: hvs-consulting/ioc_signatures
resources.desc: IOCs, CSV context and YARA rules from HvS-Consulting incident response work, organized by threat actor or campaign for threat hunting.

resources.name: trilwu/apttrail
resources.desc: APT indicators that carry the actor they belong to, its MITRE ATT&CK group ID, when they first appeared and the report that published them.

resources.name: volexity/threat-intel
resources.desc: IOCs from Volexity public threat research blog posts, organized by year and post.

resources.name: Emerging Threats Open
resources.desc: Free Proofpoint Emerging Threats ruleset for Snort and Suricata, a common baseline for network intrusion detection.

resources.name: Snort Downloads
resources.desc: Official Snort rule sets, many of which also work with Suricata.

resources.name: InQuest/yara-rules
resources.desc: YARA rules from InQuest research, intended for hunting rather than production detection; many are referenced from the InQuest blog.

resources.name: Yara-Rules/rules
resources.desc: Community-compiled YARA ruleset classified by threat type, a broad starting point for hunting.

resources.name: advanced-threat-research/Yara-Rules
resources.desc: YARA rules that accompany Trellix Advanced Threat Research (formerly McAfee ATR) blog posts and investigations.

resources.name: elastic/protections-artifacts
resources.desc: YARA rules and EQL behavior rules used by Elastic Security for endpoint, with coverage mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

resources.name: intezer/yara-rules
resources.desc: YARA rules from Intezer malware research.

resources.name: reversinglabs/reversinglabs-yara-rules
resources.desc: Detection-focused YARA rules from ReversingLabs threat analysts, written with the stated aim of zero false positives.

resources.name: x64dbg/yarasigs
resources.desc: YARA signatures for identifying packers, compilers and crypto constants, useful during reverse engineering.

resources.name: Neo23x0/yarGen
resources.desc: Generates YARA rules from malware samples while filtering out strings common in goodware.

resources.name: ninoseki/mitaka
resources.desc: Browser extension that looks up a selected IOC across many OSINT and scanning services from the context menu.

resources.name: pedramamini/ThreatIngestor
resources.desc: Extendable framework that extracts and aggregates IOCs from threat feeds and passes them to other tools.

resources.name: pedramamini/iocextract
resources.desc: Extracts IOCs from text, including defanged URLs, IP addresses and hashes.

resources.name: MISP Malware Information Sharing Platform & Threat Sharing format
resources.desc: Specifications for the MISP core format and related formats, used to exchange indicators between MISP and other platforms.

resources.name: MITRE Malware Attribute Enumeration and Characterization (MAEC™)
resources.desc: Schema for encoding malware behaviors, capabilities and attributes.

resources.name: OASIS Structured Threat Information Expression (STIX™)
resources.desc: A structured language and serialization format for exchanging cyber threat intelligence.

resources.name: YARA
resources.desc: Pattern-matching language and tool for identifying and classifying malware, used by most signature collections in this list.

resources.name: Awesome Detection Engineering
resources.desc: Designing, building and operating detection controls.

resources.name: Awesome Incident Response
resources.desc: Tools and resources for security incident response.

resources.name: Awesome Malware Analysis
resources.desc: Tools and resources for analyzing malware.

resources.name: Awesome Threat Intelligence
resources.desc: Threat intelligence sources, formats and platforms.

resources.name: Awesome YARA
resources.desc: YARA rules, tools and resources.
